entries.question: What are your opening hours?
entries.answer: Sweet Crumbs Bakery (demo) is open Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 18:00, and closed on Sunday.

entries.question: Are you open on Sunday?
aliases: Is the bakery open on Sundays?
entries.answer: No, Sweet Crumbs Bakery (demo) is closed on Sundays. We are open Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 18:00.

entries.question: Are you open on Saturday?
aliases: Is the bakery open on Saturdays?
entries.answer: Yes, Sweet Crumbs Bakery (demo) is open on Saturday from 10:00 to 18:00.

entries.question: Do you deliver?
entries.answer: We offer delivery within a limited service area. Delivery fees and availability are confirmed manually by our staff. Pickup from the bakery is also available.

entries.question: Can I pick up my cake?
entries.answer: Yes, pickup is available at the bakery during opening hours (Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 18:00).

entries.question: What cakes do you have?
aliases: What is on your cake menu?
entries.answer: Our demo menu has the Vanilla Cloud Cake (RM55), Midnight Chocolate Cake (RM70) and Red Velvet Cake (RM75). Sizes and availability are not guaranteed.

entries.question: How much is the Vanilla Cloud Cake?
aliases: What is the price of the Vanilla Cloud Cake?
entries.answer: The Vanilla Cloud Cake is RM55 (demo price). Sizes and availability are not guaranteed.

entries.question: How much is the Midnight Chocolate Cake?
aliases: What is the price of the Midnight Chocolate Cake?
entries.answer: The Midnight Chocolate Cake is RM70 (demo price). Sizes and availability are not guaranteed.

entries.question: How much is the Red Velvet Cake?
aliases: What is the price of the Red Velvet Cake?
entries.answer: The Red Velvet Cake is RM75 (demo price). Sizes and availability are not guaranteed.

entries.question: Can I order a custom cake?
aliases: Can you make a personalised cake?
entries.answer: For custom cakes, please contact our bakery staff directly; this assistant cannot take orders or payments.
